verdict.rationale: Alloy documents workflows that run on a recurring schedule as Portfolio workflows, transaction monitoring at scheduled times, and Source Workflows that automatically route submitted events without manual action. Together these are background automations the product runs itself, but they are limited to risk and compliance decisioning and documented only in brief statements. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring schedules and triggers, evidence on how autonomous the 'agentic automation' is beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
When enabled, Alloy stores the data submitted on events and automatically routes all requests
Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
